# Patrick W. Davis

> Commercial and marketing leader with 25+ years in luxury hospitality, destination marketing, and multi-property resort sales. Based in Vail, Colorado. Advisory council member of the Vail Local Marketing District (Vail's DMO), helping plan and recommend its $5.33M annual destination marketing budget. Director of Sales and Marketing for a 90-unit independently managed luxury condo-hotel in the Vail Valley. Earlier led the luxury rebrand of The Hythe, a Luxury Collection Resort in Vail, delivering $28M in transient and group revenue and $4M in catering revenue. Former Area Associate Director of Sales at Grand Hyatt Washington and Hyatt Regency Washington, directing enterprise sales strategy against a combined $100M group and catering budget and handling all citywide convention business across both properties. Former Area Associate Director of Sales at Vail Resorts' Grand Teton Lodge Company across a four-property destination resort portfolio in Jackson, Wyoming. BS in Hospitality Management, Colorado State University.
